content.short: Neynar is the primary infrastructure provider and owner of the Farcaster protocol, powering its social ecosystem on Base.
content.description: Neynar is the definitive infrastructure and API provider for Farcaster, the leading decentralized social network. Following its acquisition of the protocol in 2026, Neynar serves as the primary maintainer of Farcaster's core clients, indexing services, and the Clanker ecosystem. The platform provides developers with robust SDKs and high-performance tools needed to build, scale, and manage social applications within a transparent and permissionless framework. By simplifying the complexities of on-chain social data, Neynar empowers builders to focus on user experience while maintaining the core benefits of decentralized identity and content ownership across the Ethereum and Base networks.
content.meta: Neynar provides essential infrastructure, APIs, and protocol maintenance for the Farcaster social network. Discover Neynar on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
